diagnosedCause: V4 writes authored position and orientation controllers on the model root, while retail ModelType 2 part MDLs keep the model root controllerless and put transform controllers on direct Trimesh children.
V4 accepts bounding-box agreement without emulating Aurora's ordered ModelPart1, ModelPart2 and ModelPart3 append semantics.
V4 treats tolerance-qualified gaps as sufficient adjacency instead of requiring explicit connector overlap.
V4 can repeat generated child-node names across independent part MDLs.
minimalIntendedDelta: Bake source-axis rotation into geometry and leave only translation on direct Trimesh children.
Emit controllerless model roots, Aurora-compatible child node flags and globally unique resref-derived child names.
Fit Bottom, Middle and Top with explicit positive connector overlap while rejecting non-adjacent overlap.
Require node-aware binary MDL append conformance for all four colorways before MOD/HAK materialization.
